title: Calling down big pots with no pair and no draw
note: 74 hands over 40bb with no pair and no draw cost -1,219bb. 22 of them went to showdown for -731bb (-33bb each); the other 52 were built and abandoned for -487bb. 22.8bb in per hand, 15.1 of it postflop.

title: Stacking off with a weak pair in big pots
note: 74 big pots held with second pair, bottom pair or an underpair: -660bb at 30.7bb in per hand. Mostly small and medium pocket pairs played as if they were overpairs after an overcard landed.

title: SB cold calls instead of raising or folding
note: 46 SB cold calls plus 19 SB completes over 11,190 hands. Net cost is currently nil, so this is a discipline item, not a bleed - but the SB is the one seat where flatting has no upside.

title: Betting flop and turn with no pair and no draw in medium pots
note: 246 hands at 15-40bb with no pair and no draw cost -792bb (8.7bb in per hand). Turn bets that ended with no pair: 182 hands, -416bb, even though 109 of them took the pot. Small bets (median 46% pot) into players who call with any pair. Examples from 2026-10-05: A5o on JT3-8 called down by 99; KJo 1/4-pot turn stab called by AJ-high; T8o turn bluff-raise on K62-3.
